def test_catalogue_list_and_get():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0

    sock = socks[0]
    sock_id = sock["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_sock = resp.json()
    assert fetched_sock["id"] == sock_id
    assert fetched_sock["name"] == sock["name"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags = resp.json().get("tags", [])
    if tags:
        tag = tags[0]
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        filtered_socks = resp.json()
        for s in filtered_socks:
            assert tag in s.get("tag", [])

def test_carts_add_update_delete():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    helper_register_user(username)

    item_id, unit_price = helper_get_catalogue_item()

    item_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": unit_price}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 1

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 2

    patch_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 5, "unitPrice": unit_price}
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=patch_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_orders_create_and_search():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    helper_register_user(username)
    addr_id = helper_add_address(username)
    card_id = helper_add_card(username)
    item_id, unit_price = helper_get_catalogue_item()
    helper_add_cart_item(username, item_id, unit_price, 2)

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username
    assert len(order.get("items", [])) == 1
    assert order["items"][0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert order["items"][0]["quantity"] == 2

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order["id"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in customer_orders)

def test_payment_and_shipping_e2e():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    helper_register_user(username)
    addr_id = helper_add_address(username)
    card_id = helper_add_card(username)
    item_id, unit_price = helper_get_catalogue_item()
    helper_add_cart_item(username, item_id, unit_price, 1)

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    order_resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert order_resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {order_resp.status_code}: {order_resp.text}"
    order_id = order_resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "123", "postcode": "12345", "street": "Street"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) >= 1
    assert auths[-1]["orderId"] == order_id
    assert auths[-1]["authorised"] in [True, False]

    shipping_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "123", "postcode": "12345", "street": "Street"},
        "itemCount": 1,
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("shipping-http", "/shipping"), json=shipping_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment["orderId"] == order_id
    assert "trackingNumber" in shipment

def test_user_register_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    payload = {"username": username, "password": password, "email": email, "firstName": "Test", "lastName": "User"}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cust = resp.json()
    assert cust.get("username") == username
    assert cust.get("firstName") == "Test"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_addresses_and_cards():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    helper_register_user(username)

    addr_id = helper_add_address(username)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in addrs)

    card_id = helper_add_card(username)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in addrs)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert not any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)
